pure-announcement.rationale: It coins and argues for a generational framing of observability tooling rather than announcing any release, though it is written by the vendor whose product exemplifies the framing.

duplicate.rationale: No supplied nearest concept touches observability tooling generations, but note the staged companion piece 'there-is-only-one-key-difference' distils this same central idea.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The storage-model claims are checkable against cited primary material (Stripe canonical logs, AWS service logs, Scuba paper) and against any team's own telemetry bill.

durability.rationale: The write-time vs read-time aggregation trade-off and the cardinality-driven cost contrast between metrics stores and wide-event stores will hold in twelve months, even though the ZIRP commentary and five-year predictions are period colour.

actionability.rationale: It is mostly manifesto and landscape contrast — the concrete build guidance (instrument with wide events, derive SLOs at read time, practise observability-driven development) is directional here and is stated more sharply in the later distilled piece.

atomicity.rationale: Every 1.0-vs-2.0 contrast in the piece is a consequence of the single statable idea that the generations differ by one-versus-many sources of telemetry truth.
